qt: to the Commission Marc Botenga (The Left) Subject:

The Commission condemned Belarus’ decision to make its territory available to Russia for the latter’s aggression against Ukraine. The President of the Commission described Belarus as ‘the other aggressor’, in particular because it had granted Russian forces access to its territory. The European Union subsequently sanctioned Belarus1. During the United States’ illegal war on Iran, which began on 28 February 2026, a number of European countries have also made military bases, airports and other infrastructure located in their territory available to US forces. According to the NATO Secretary‑General, Italy has allowed 500 US aircraft to take off from its soil to take part in military operations. Romania is reported to have authorised tanker aircraft to take off from its civilian airports. Ramstein Air Base in Germany has been used to direct and coordinate this war of aggression. 1.

In the context of the illegal war on Iran, does the Commission take the view that making territory, infrastructure and airspace available to the United States means that the countries concerned are complicit in this aggression?
If so, what action does it propose to ensure that the EU and its Member States respect international law, as the Treaty requires?
If not, why does it consider Belarus to be complicit in Russia’s aggression, but does not view the countries concerned as being complicit in the US aggression?
at: EN on behalf of the European Commission (23.10.2026) The actions by the individual Member States in the exercise of their competences cannot be attributed to the EU. Since there is no EU position as regards possible assistance to the US in the context of its activities vis-à-vis Iran, neither the Commission nor the High Representative/Vice-President have any role under the Treaties in the assessment of the Member States actions described in the questions. It is different in relation to the Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine, with respect to which a comprehensive EU position has been established.
